findings.summary: __xsk_buff_get_metadata() validates shared-memory meta->flags once then returns the raw UMEM-resident pointer; downstream xsk_tx_metadata_request() (include/net/xdp_sock.h:178-181) re-fetches flags and csum_start/csum_offset from the same user-writable memory without READ_ONCE/local copy/lock, so the consumed offsets can differ from the validated state.

candidates_final.reason: single struct-copy by value; validation on local copy
consumption site of the reported finding; igc lacks tmo_request_checksum so only launch_time reaches driver code
